scope: Make message lifecycle methods describe events and own generation completion, interruption sequencing, and message cleanup
acceptance_criteria: Event handlers use consistent OnEvent naming; I/O commands and configuration retain explicit command names
One generation-completed event updates generation state and closes text generation without completing undelivered playback
Lifecycle owns interrupted-turn reservation, flush, commit, provider-update ordering, and held-input release
Lifecycle handles pause success or failure and owns decision-timer arming
One Close operation cancels active message timers and returns any required playback continuation
Dispatcher only routes packets, performs I/O, and reports failures
Preserve existing stale-event checks, flush-failure policy, staged interruption setting, and once-only completion
No new protocol, helper package, generic state setter, or lifecycle owner

ownership.coordinator: Interface, generation completion, cleanup, dispatcher integration, remaining lifecycle tests, validation
ownership.adapter_test_worker: Adapter internal test callers and regressions

risks: Callbacks must not run under the lifecycle state lock
Held speech must not replay before provider turn updates finish
Generation-completed events must not overwrite active playout or imply delivery completion
Removing duplicate generation state updates can expose tests relying on setter-only setup

verification_results.test_race_correction: New finalization test packet capture changed from an unsynchronized slice to a buffered channel; ten repeated race runs passed

independent_review.summary: Verified generation finality, speech-state preservation, interruption callback ordering, pause results, cleanup, and retained playback/idle regression coverage
independent_review.nonblocking_coverage_note: Generation closure before EOS and packet publication after EOS were verified by inspection; this specific ordering has no focused adapter regression test

rollback: Revert only this event-contract change, retaining the earlier API and declaration cleanup
